subject: Coordinate 30m demo + security touchpoint for AuroraCloud
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@auracloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + scheduling a 30m intro demo

Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for a great discovery call this morning. Quick recap / next steps from our side: 
- Main priority: evaluate a hosted inference flow for AuroraCloud’s customer-facing search assistant (Gen AI).
- Key constraints you mentioned: 99th pct latency under 350ms for short queries, predictable monthly spend, and SOC 2 evidence for procurement.
- Stakeholders: you (product), Tom Reed (infra/security), and a technical reviewer (you mentioned an ML engineer).

We recommend a short 30-minute intro demo (product + brief infra/security touchpoint) so we can:
1) show a targeted walkthrough of the inference runtime and latency controls,
2) surface deployment options (hosted vs dedicated), and
3) confirm security/compliance artifacts and procurement timeline.

Please pick one of these 30-minute windows (all PST):
- Option A: Thu Dec 10, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Thu Dec 10, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Option C: Fri Dec 11, 8:30–9:00 AM PT

If none work, tell me two times that do and we’ll adapt. I’ve attached the SOC2 summary and a mutual action plan draft to speed procurement review. I’ll include Jordan (solutions engineer) and Neha (sales lead) on the call so we have the right technical/contract context.

Attachments: [SOC2-summary.pdf (PDF, 320KB)], [mutual_action_plan.docx (DOCX, 120KB)]

Thanks — looking forward to locking a time.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0192

From: Alicia Moreno <alicia.moreno@auracloud.com>

Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@auracloud.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + scheduling a 30m intro demo

Evelyn — thanks for the clear recap and attachments. This is helpful.

Tom and I took a quick look at the SOC2 summary; good start. Tom, can you confirm whether you want a separate 15-minute security deep-dive, or if we should handle the key compliance questions during the same 30-minute session?

For times, Option A (Thu Dec 10, 10:00 AM PT) works best for product and infra. If Jordan will demo the runtime, can we ask for a 10-minute kickoff to ensure our ML engineer (Maya) can join at 10:05 PT?

Also, one small ask: can you include a note about token cost assumptions in the mutual action plan before we share with procurement? That will make internal approvals faster.

Thanks — confirm once calendar invite is out.

Alicia
Sr. Product Manager, AuroraCloud
alicia.moreno@auracloud.com

See HubSpot link for the draft doc.

Evelyn
